environment.description: Quarkus native-image serverless function deployed on Kubernetes 1.24 cluster. Container runs as root (UID 0) with SYS_PTRACE capability. Pod spec mounts hostPath /var/log/host for centralized logging. Container image includes libacme_transform.so compiled without stack canaries (-fno-stack-protector). No seccomp profile applied. CRASH_DUMP_PATH set to /var/log/host/crashes allowing writes to host filesystem.
